summary: The scalar/coprime multiplication theorems and their supporting lemmas are the right surface, but the PR ships a four-lemma dead-end chain of public scalar-diagonal lemmas with no consumer, and the sole public export of the new CongruenceSplit module states an unnamed unfolding of a private predicate instead of the congruence-subgroup spelling the repo already uses.
